_evidence: 0x00419220 reads dwords a=[esi+0x2f4], b=[esi+0x2f8] and divides a*X + b*Y (64-bit, imul/add/adc) by a+b (32-bit; zero becomes 1) with X, Y the absolute fistp products of state_00419220 (|X|,|Y| <= 60000). With |a|,|b| <= 1000 the dividend is below 1.2e8 in magnitude, so every quotient fits (no #DE) - including a = -b, which divides by 1; unbounded weights can #DE. The edge-weighted range draws a+b = 0 in a few percent of the cases.
